title: DeepRAG: Thinking to Retrieve Step by Step for Large Language Models
authors: Xinyan Guan; Jiali Zeng; Fandong Meng; Chunlei Xin; Yaojie Lu; Hongyu Lin; Xianpei Han; Le Sun; Jie Zhou
why_relevant: DeepRAG addresses adaptive retrieval decisions—when to retrieve vs. trust parametric knowledge—via MDP-based step-by-step reasoning, directly relevant to calibration/control of retrieval and knowledge boundary awareness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on efficiency and reasoning rather than robustness to noisy/adversarial evidence per se.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
